description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff. You will play a key role in educating our team and implementing robust infection control protocols.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in fostering a culture of continuous learning and safety. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact within a supportive healthcare setting. We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42 per hour for this essential position.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity for a results-oriented professional to significantly impact our community outreach and census growth. We are committed to offering competitive compensation for the right individual who can drive success.As Marketing Director, you will be instrumental in developing and executing strategic marketing plans to enhance the facility's presence and attract new residents. This role requires a proactive and driven individual with a 'hustler' mentality, capable of building strong relationships within the community and consistently achieving occupancy goals. You will also be expected to work occasional weekends to support community events and outreach initiatives.
requirements: Minimum of 3-5 years of marketing experience, preferably in a healthcare or skilled nursing facility setting
Demonstrated ability to be presentable and maintain a professional demeanor
Proven track record as a proactive, results-driven marketing professional with a strong focus on census growth
Flexibility to work occasional weekends for community events and outreach
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as-needed) role offers the flexibility to work around your schedule while providing essential therapy services to patients.

As a Physical Therapist, you will play a crucial role in helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will develop and implement individualized treatment plans, collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, and contribute to a positive and supportive environment focused on patient recovery and well-being. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled PT looking for flexible work.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program
Prior experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting is preferred
Ability to work on a PRN (as-needed) basis, demonstrating flexibility and reliability
Strong communication, interpersonal, and documentation skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for Physical Therapists is in the range of $39.00 - $40.00, based on experience and full-time equivalent rates.

description:
We are seeking dedicated Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA), Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA), Occupational Therapists (OT), and Speech Therapists (ST) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Ocala, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for both full-time and part-time professionals to contribute to a patient-centered environment focused on recovery and well-being. You will play a crucial role in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life.

Join a supportive team committed to delivering exceptional rehabilitative care. We offer competitive compensation for qualified candidates, reflecting your experience and dedication to making a positive impact on our residents' lives.
requirements: Current state licensure/certification as a COTA, PTA, OT, or ST in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Commitment to patient-centered care and interdisciplinary collaboration
salaryOrBonusInfo: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) / Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA): $28.00 - $37.00/hr. Occupational Therapist (OT) / Speech Therapist (ST): $40.00 - $46.00/hr. Compensation is based on experience and role.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Full-time Occupational Therapist (OT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Ocala, FL. This is a critical role where you will play a vital part in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life through comprehensive therapy programs. If you are passionate about making a significant impact in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply.

As an Occupational Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment plans for residents. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure the highest standard of care and facilitate optimal patient outcomes. This position offers a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to contribute to a thriving rehabilitation team.
requirements: Current Occupational Therapist (OT) license in Florida
Graduate of an accredited Occupational Therapy program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work full-time hours
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $48.00, based on experience.
